name: SIAT belt grasper
full_name: SIAT second-generation robotic catheter system for cardiovascular intervention (belt-driven graspers)
group: Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, CAS (Lei Wang; Olatunji Mumini Omisore)
versions: omisore2018_towards (TBCAS 2018, second generation); the same lab's third-generation isomorphic primary-secondary system (du2024_analyzing, omisore2024_sample, duan2025_development) is row siat_haptic_duan2025; 2011-14: SIAT first-generation master-slave robot (P. Zhang 2011 ICMA; Mi 2014 ICMA) (Alekseeva 2025 Table 2 row 5; Belikov 2024 Fig. 6 MIs; Zhao 2022 Table 1 row 15b) (alekseeva2025_design; belikov2024_evolution; zhao2022_remote)
target_anatomy: radial artery through axillary and subclavian arteries to the aortic arch (tubular phantoms)
devices_driven: one 9 Fr, 130 cm unactuated catheter sheath (no steerable catheters)
rotation_detail: Rotary drive grasper on a Maxon EC16 motor; belt carries four axial drive graspers for continuous push (Maxon EC32)
device_range: 9 Fr catheter sheath; two guiding sheaths of 35 mm length, 10 mm inner diameter at the belt ends
mass_kg: about 9.5 (S8 evidence reading of Sec. II-C); battery 10,000 mAh, 220 +/- 27 min
force_sensing: Strain gauges on the 9 Fr sheath, 5 mm and 25 mm from the tip (gauge factor 2.08, 120 ohm), Coulomb friction term subtracted; EM sensor (NDI Aurora) in the lumen for tip motion
validation_detail: Tubular PVC phantoms (10 mm) from the radial artery to the aortic arch; one insertion with compensation and none without (S8 reading)
key_numbers: Backlash gaps 3.94-9.30 mm between motor encoder and tip EM sensor; adaptive neuro-fuzzy compensation final error 0.4 mm (duan2023_progress, review statement); sensor accuracy 0.9 mm / 0.8 deg
sim2real_detail: none found for this generation. The 2024 DRL PID-tuning study (omisore2024_sample, full) ran on the current-generation slave (Sec. II-A: "The current generation is an isomorphic master-slave RCS"; 57 x 22 x 16 cm, 4 DoF), not on this belt-driven robot: see row siat_haptic_duan2025.
